title: WLD-22 Weld Fatigue Assessment
text: Weld WLD-22 joining PART-118 to the chassis rail was assessed for fatigue under the LC-7 duty cycle. The stress range at the weld toe is 78 MPa at an R ratio of 0.1, giving a predicted life of 2100000 cycles against a 1000000 cycle requirement. The toe was ground flush, which the assessment assumes.
